summary: A stuck job no longer blocks work for hours; it is caught and restarted.

new.title: Hanging jobs are stopped and restarted
new.text: A job that makes no progress for 60 minutes, or runs far longer than usual, is stopped and started once more. Before, it ran until its time limit.

new.title: Repeated hangs stop and get attention
new.text: A job that hangs again within 24 hours stays stopped and shows on Runs with the reason. Invardia support is told at once. An update is never stopped half-way.
